strings.name: Leymah Gbowee
strings.summary: Trained in social work and trauma counseling, Gbowee mobilized Christian and Muslim women whose nonviolent campaign helped end Liberia’s civil war in 2003. She shared the 2011 Nobel Peace Prize with Ellen Johnson Sirleaf and Tawakkol Karman, founded an education and leadership foundation, and continues advocating grassroots participation and women’s leadership.
